conversation.body: Plan: split AppContainer into per-app containers (flat access via inheritance), 10 phases in 7 waves, never more than 2 wide because billing -> webhooks -> calendar -> organizations are real code dependencies. Least sure of: (1) that an alias line (name = Upstream.name) in a subclass body behaves as assumed -- Phase 1's test decides, fallback is in Open Questions; (2) that billing belongs in payments/ rather than billing_integration/; (3) whether per-module phases are worth 7 waves vs bundling.
I think we should must limit the agents to run the full suite, could you make them use the semaphore system

Done: added a capacity-1 `test-suite` semaphore (matches uv run pytest / python -m pytest / pytest / make test) and made the `test` gate require it, so only one suite runs at a time across parallel lanes. Agents must run pytest as `vinta-ai-maestro with test-suite -- <cmd>`.
